outcome: Total adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes
cohort: This study included 1,556 Chinese singleton pregnant women with negative thyroid peroxidase antibodies (TPOAb) who were diagnosed with either subclinical hypothyroidism or euthyroidism.
finding: The 2017 ATA guidelines for diagnosing subclinical hypothyroidism were more sensitive than the 2011 guidelines in identifying adverse pregnancy outcomes in Chinese women with negative TPOAb.
